$comment: Named options of how work runs in this repository. CLAUDE.md shows them in a block written by scripts/project-options.js (npm run options); tests read the values from here.

review_rounds.means: fix rounds between circuit-reviewer and the same circuit-layout agent before the main conversation steps in

briefs_per_agent.means: circuits one agent works on; a new circuit gets a new agent (its fix rounds stay with it)

context_kb.means: what a session in this repository loads at start, at most (CLAUDE.md, agent headers, MCP instructions and tool schemas; scripts/context-size.js)
